projects.title: Pegmatite Lithium Exploration
projects.description: Lithium exploration across zoned pegmatite corridors in the Dodoma region, integrating detailed litho-structural mapping, systematic geochemical sampling, and mineralogical prospectivity evaluation.

projects.title: Cu-Zn Base Metals Exploration
projects.description: Comprehensive copper-zinc polymetallic exploration programme in Mpanda district comprising grid soil geochemistry, bedrock trenching, and ground geophysical surveys to delineate mineralized shear zones.

projects.title: Coal Outcrop Structural Mapping
projects.description: High-resolution geological and stratigraphic mapping of coal seam outcrops in Liweta, Tanzania, delivering seam correlation, structural fault analysis, and coal quality sampling for resource modelling.

projects.title: Diamond Core Drilling Supervision
projects.description: Turnkey diamond core drilling supervision for resource definition and scout exploration, ensuring high core recovery, oriented structural logging, RQD geotechnical recording, and strict QA/QC sampling.

projects.title: Mazizi Gold Mineralization Study
projects.description: Geological investigation of structurally controlled gold mineralization at Mazizi in Morogoro region, encompassing outcrop mapping, channel sampling, and drill target prioritization.

projects.title: Active Coal Mine Face Mapping
images: images/projects/Face mapping in a coal mine.jpg
projects.description: Production face mapping and stratigraphic seam control within active coal mining operations, supporting short-term mine scheduling, roof/wall stability, and ROM coal quality consistency.

projects.title: Graphite-Kyanite Gneiss Evaluation
projects.description: Geological and mineralogical evaluation of flake graphite and kyanite-bearing gneiss horizons in Merelani, establishing strike continuity and grade distribution.

projects.title: Graphite Gneiss Stockpile QA/QC
images: images/projects/Graphite kyanite gneiss stockpile in Merelani.jpg
projects.description: Systematic stockpile volumetric survey, representative sampling, and grade quality verification for graphite-kyanite-gneiss ROM material in Merelani to determine commercial processing viability.

projects.title: Beryllium Geochemical Prospecting
projects.description: Multi-disciplinary beryllium prospecting campaign in Namtumbo integrating geological traversing, pegmatite zonation mapping, and geochemical sampling.

projects.title: Namtumbo Beryllium Assessment
projects.description: Targeted geological assessment and verification sampling of beryllium-bearing occurrences in Namtumbo district to establish licence prospectivity for private investment.

projects.title: Industrial Dolomite Prospecting
projects.description: Carbonate mapping and chemical purity sampling across dolomite horizons in Dodoma region to evaluate industrial, agricultural, and construction-grade resource potential.

projects.title: High-Purity Quartz Prospecting
projects.description: Field prospecting, vein geometry mapping, and purity assessment of quartz deposits in the Morogoro region for commercial and industrial mineral supply.

projects.title: Artisanal Gold Mining Technical Support
projects.description: Field geological advisory, vein structural tracking, workplace safety assessment, and ore recovery guidance for artisanal gold mining cooperatives in Tabora region.

projects.title: Small-Scale Mining Advisory & Training
projects.description: Technical site assessment and practical operator training for small-scale miners in Morogoro focused on safe benching, geological ore control, and environmental stewardship.
